compiled_state.title: As a code reviewer agent, I inherit a calibrated severity rubric and carve-outs from reviewer-base.md
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add a severity calibration rubric section to reviewer-base.md with at least 5 concrete MINOR-not-IMPORTANT examples sourced from the PR #37 bug tickets, plus carve-outs (e.g., "moved/renamed code with all callsites updated → MINOR, not CRITICAL"). Rebuild all 10 reviewer agent files via build-review-agents.sh.

**Why**: Miscalibrated severity is the primary cause of false positives that erode developer trust. A rubric with real examples anchors the reviewer's judgment to the patterns that have historically caused over-escalation.

**Scope**:
- IN: Severity calibration rubric section in reviewer-base.md; rebuild of all 10 agent files via build-review-agents.sh; verification that rubric text appears in all generated files
- OUT: NOT-flag auto-downgrade rules (S2), CI context marker (S3), cited_lines evidence field (S4)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, reviewer-base.md contains a severity calibration rubric section with at least 5 concrete MINOR-not-IMPORTANT examples and explicit carve-outs (including "moved/renamed code with all callsites updated → MINOR, not CRITICAL")
  ← Satisfies: "reviewer-base.md contains a severity calibration rubric section with 5+ concrete MINOR-not-IMPORTANT examples sourced from the 13 PR #37 bug tickets, plus carve-outs"
- When this story is complete, all 10 generated reviewer agent files are rebuilt via build-review-agents.sh and each file contains the severity calibration rubric text inherited from reviewer-base.md
  ← Satisfies: "All 10 generated agent files inherit it via build-review-agents.sh"
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] New section must use structural pattern (markdown heading + bullet list) compatible with agent-authoring sub-agents (cross-epic a8e8-0b23) — verify structural pattern before committing
- [Cross-epic] RT-4: Before editing reviewer-base.md, verify its current state against in-flight epics db68-ca95 (LLM blindspot hardening, adds rubric text to same files) and e82e-3888 (Security reference APIs, modifies same security reviewer agents) — if those epics have landed text, rebase new sections to coexist without heading anchor conflicts that break build-review-agents.sh

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
